title: Intune Device Configuration & Policy Troubleshooting Toolkit
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Find out why an Intune policy isn't landing — and fix it
problem: A configuration profile shows “assigned” but the setting never reaches the device — and the admin is left guessing. This toolkit gives you a structured root-cause method and diagnostic scripts for Intune device-configuration and settings-catalog policies: assignment and targeting, group and filter scoping, policy conflicts and precedence, MDM sync and check-in, and Company Portal state — so you isolate the failing layer in minutes instead of re-pushing blindly.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how a policy travels from assignment to applied state (assignment → group/filter scope → sync → CSP apply → report), and the layered model behind the root-cause tree.
Requirements Guide — what you need to diagnose (Intune admin roles, Graph read access, device access for logs) with how to verify each.

Diagnostic Playbook — a symptom-driven decision tree (not assigned, assigned-not-applied, conflict/precedence, filter excludes device, stuck sync, error code) with the exact checks and the layer each isolates.

5 PowerShell scripts — policy/assignment discovery, per-device applied-state validation, an assignment + conflict coverage report, safe re-sync/remediation of stuck devices, and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides mapping each pass/fail gate to the fix, plus Best Practices for naming, filters, and conflict-free policy design.
short: A structured root-cause method and scripts to diagnose why an Intune configuration/settings-catalog policy isn't applying — assignment, filters, conflicts, sync, and CSP errors — isolate the failing layer fast. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: A structured root-cause method and scripts to diagnose why an Intune configuration/settings-catalog policy isn't applying — assignment, filters, conflicts, sync, and CSP errors.
